entry.confirm_signal: After the last step the rising tone sequence sounds four times.
steps: Battery disconnected, stick to full throttle, transmitter on.
Connect a charged flight battery: rising tone sequence, then in LiPo mode cell-count beeps.
Stick to centre: rising tone sequence four times, programming mode.

announce.description: Parameter N sounds as N beeps, repeated until the stick moves. After the parameter 9 beeps the programming ends with stick centre then stick to motor OFF.

select.description: Choose the value by moving the stick to full throttle (first option) or to motor OFF (second option); the ESC answers with a confirmation signal.

skip.description: Return the stick to centre to leave the parameter unchanged or after a change; the ESC goes to the next parameter.

scheme.confirm_signal: Long tone for parameter 1; 'confirmation signal' for the others (tone not described).
scheme.exit: Stick centre (rising tone sequence), then stick to motor OFF: rising tone sequence twice, parameters stored.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up, then centre, full, centre enters programming (four rising sequences). Parameters 1 to 9 sound as 1 to 9 repeated beeps. Full throttle or motor OFF selects the option; centre moves on. Centre then motor OFF after parameter 9 stores and exits.

values.name: LiPo with automatic cutoff (stick full throttle), default; motor off at 3.0 V per cell
NiXX (stick motor OFF); motor off at 6.0 V

items.name: Motor cutoff type

values.name: motor cut, hard stop (stick full throttle)

items.note: Power reduction starts at 3.2 V per cell (LiPo) or 6.0 V (NiXX) and the motor is off at 2.9 V or 5.8 V.

items.name: Motor start-up
items.note: Start-up time: soft 3.0 s helicopter and 1.3 s fixed-wing; standard 1.0 s helicopter and 0.2 s fixed-wing.

values.name: automatic timing on (stick full throttle), default

items.name: Manual timing (only if automatic timing is off)

values.name: hard timing 22-30 degrees, outrunners (stick full throttle)
soft timing 7 degrees, inrunners (stick motor OFF)
helicopter, governor mode (stick full throttle); brake forced off

unknowns: Beep duration, gap and the interval between repeats: not stated.
Time to hold each stick position in the entry sequence: not stated.
Timing of the 'confirmation signal' tones: not stated.
Whether stick centre alone after parameter 9 (10.1) with rising tone sequence is required: manual gives 10.1 stick centre, 10.2 stick motor OFF.
Stick-position pulse widths: not stated (the manual refers to the radio's full-throttle, centre and motor OFF positions).
Value numbers 1 and 2 are the order the manual lists the options in; the ESC does not sound them.
Spec table columns for 715, 720 and 755 are read from a merged table; current and BEC numbers per column follow the column order of Multiplex_Roxxy_BL-715_S-BEC.pdf.
Cell counts for the 755 are taken from the 740/755 manual (2-6S LiPo).
notes: Multiplex_Roxxy_BL-715_S-BEC.pdf (715/720/755, 2019) and Multiplex_BL-Control_740-755_S-BEC.pdf (740/755, 2020) carry the same programming steps.
Multiplex_Roxxy_BL-755_S-BEC.pdf has the same English text as Multiplex_Roxxy_BL-715_S-BEC.pdf (it covers 715/720/755) although the index lists it as 755 only.
announce.repeat 0 means the sequence repeats until a choice is made (manual: "continuous").
